themes.twistDescription: No twist — copied verbatim. Warm cream base (#fcf7f1), near-black text, transparent nav, deep navy accent (#1e3a6e). color_register_actual: light (luminance 247.8 > 190 threshold).

Twist B: Letter spacing injection (0.06em on all headings). All proprietary fonts replaced with Google Fonts CDN imports: nbarchitekt→Manrope (geometric grotesque, warm, precise), Times→EB Garamond (classic serif body, editorial), Arial→Work Sans (clean UI/button register).
Twist A: Duration scaling ×1.5. All transition durations multiplied: 0.5s→0.75s, 0.2s→0.3s, 0.3s→0.45s, 0.4s→0.6s, 0.85s→1.275s. The system slows to a deliberate, measured pace.
Twist A: Container max-width tightened 15% (1728px→1468px). Creates tighter typographic measure and more deliberate margins on wide viewports, reinforcing the printed-page editorial register.
Twist C: Hero padding emphasis ×1.5. Hero paddingTop/Bottom amplified from 96px to 144px. Nav and section spacing preserved. The hero gains monumental breathing room.

Twist A: Hover transition speed made more languid (+0.15s, intensity 3). All hover transitions raised to 0.45s. The system does not snap — it settles. Consistent with the 1.5× motion duration scaling.

Twist A: Nav height adjustment +16px (intensity 3). 32px→48px default, with 40px scrolled state. The nav gains deliberate presence without mass. Uppercase micro-typography at 0.75rem with 0.08em letter spacing.

Tone twist: The Notable UX/UI Observations section rewritten to be more material and analytical — emphasizing typographic temperature as register signal, letter spacing as structural device rather than decoration. concept_by_video.md generated with letterpress/material motion vocabulary matching the warm cream/precision register.
